text:
alex: Heads-up — starting TF apply for staging subnet change in the 20:00-20:30 UTC change window. Plan: single-AZ canary -> staging verify. Enabling deploybot quiet-mode and kill-switch. Pinning module.subnet to v1.4.2. @priya please ack IAM pin and release note snippet.
deploybot: preflight OK. terraform plan complete, no drift detected. resources to change: 5. run-id=run-2412345678. quiet-mode=ON. kill-switch=ARMED. Abort command: `/deploybot abort run-2412345678`.
priya: ack. Holding IAM edits for canary. Pin applied in branch release/infra/2026-03-20-subnet -> module.subnet v1.4.2. Adding release note: "Staging: subnet-sizing tweak to improve autoscaling headroom. module.subnet -> v1.4.2 (no data migration)".
jamie: Suggest lowering parallelism for this one — set apply concurrency to 2 so canary failures are smaller blast radius.
alex: agree. will run with `-parallelism=2`. Also set TF_VAR_force_kill=false. Command I will run below.
sre-oncall: Quick Q — if we abort via kill-switch, do we automatically revert state or just stop the run?
maria: Abort stops apply and marks run FAILED. Manual rollback steps in playbook:
1) `terraform state pull > state.json` to snapshot
2) revert module version in git and open PR if needed
3) `terraform apply -auto-approve` on the reverted config to restore previous resources
OR for targeted revert: `terraform state rm <resource>` then recreate. See infra runbook -> rollback section.
priya: copying those steps into the release note and tagging owners.
alex: starting canary apply now on staging. running:
```
$ terraform workspace select staging
$ git checkout release/infra/2026-03-20-subnet
$ terraform apply -auto-approve -parallelism=2 -var="module_subnet_version=v1.4.2"
```
deploybot: run-2412345678 APPLY STARTED. streaming logs: planning -> applying -> resource_changes: 5 to change.
maria: seeing a failure: aws_subnet_association.az-b failed to associate (timeout). I'm going to abort to avoid cross-AZ impact.
alex: do abort now if you think impact will spread.
maria: `/deploybot abort run-2412345678` — executed.
deploybot: ABORT RECEIVED for run-2412345678. Stopping apply. Marking run as ABORTED. Attempting best-effort cleanup for partially applied resources.
alex: confirmed abort. Moving to rollback plan: reverting module version on branch and re-evaluating association logic. We'll spin up a small repro in a sandbox before reattempt.
priya: will open a hotfix branch to pin previous subnet config and update release notes. tagging network-owner and autoscaling-owner.
sre-oncall: filing a short incident QA: why did az-b association time out? please dump relevant cloudtrail/troubleshooting logs in #incidents.
alex: will post logs and next steps. thanks all. :thumbsup:
